# f5xc_network_firewall (Resource)

Network Firewall is applicable when referred to by a Fleet. The Network Firewall will be applied to all<br>sites that are member of the referring Fleet.<br><br>It is applied on all virtual networks that are valid on this site that get instantiated due to fleet object.<br>Network Firewall defines following,<br>- network_policy_set - L3/L4 policies to be applied in all sites that are member of the fleet<br>- forward_proxy_policy_set - L7 firewall to be applied in all sites that are member of the fleet<br>- fast_acl_set - List of Fast ACL set to be applied in all sites that are member of the fleet.

To get more information about f5xc_network_firewall, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/network-firewall)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Network Firewall - Enhanced Firewall Dependency

resource "f5xc_enhanced_firewall_policy" "dep" {
  name      = "example-network-firewall-efp"
  namespace = "system"

  rule_choice = {
    allow_all = true
  }
}

resource "f5xc_network_firewall" "example" {
  name      = "example-network-firewall"
  namespace = "system"

  labels = {
    env  = "example"
    team = "platform"
  }

  annotations = {
    owner      = "example-owner"
    dependency = f5xc_enhanced_firewall_policy.dep.name
  }

  depends_on = [f5xc_enhanced_firewall_policy.dep]
}
```

```terraform
# Example: Network Firewall - Forward Proxy And Fast Acl Dependencies

resource "f5xc_forward_proxy_policy" "dep" {
  name      = "example-network-firewall-65yn2k-922000-fpp"
  namespace = "system"

  proxy_choice = {
    any_proxy = true
  }

  rule_choice = {
    allow_all = true
  }
}

resource "f5xc_fast_acl" "dep" {
  name      = "example-network-firewall-65yn2k-922000-fast-acl"
  namespace = "system"

  site_choice = {
    site_acl = {
      network_choice = {
        outside_network = true
      }
      vip_choice = {
        all_services = true
      }
    }
  }
}

resource "f5xc_network_firewall" "example" {
  name      = "example-network-firewall"
  namespace = "system"

  description = "Network firewall example depending on forward proxy and fast ACL"

  annotations = {
    forward_proxy_dependency = f5xc_forward_proxy_policy.dep.name
    fast_acl_dependency      = f5xc_fast_acl.dep.name
  }

  depends_on = [
    f5xc_forward_proxy_policy.dep,
    f5xc_fast_acl.dep,
  ]
}
```
